# moment 9: a sub-agent from an earlier turn has reported; two presses of ctrl+c stop the two spawned next, and each gets one report row after the stop note.
type subagents-9-earlier-turn
key enter
wait c1 read the loader.
once report [&c1]
type subagents-9-ctrl-c-twice-draws-each-parked-report
key enter
wait waiting on 2 sub-agents
key ctrl+c
wait this will stop 2 sub-agents, press Ctrl+C again to confirm
key ctrl+c
wait stopping the turn
clock 1s
once report [&c1]
once report [&c2]
once report [&c3]
before stopping the turn | report [&c2]
before stopping the turn | report [&c3]
